description: This file contains unit tests for the ThingDefinitionModified class, which is part of the Eclipse Ditto library. The tests verify immutability, correct implementation of equals and hashCode, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: ThingDefinitionModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ThingDefinitionModified class, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path correctness.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the ThingDefinitionModified class, and related classes, are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals() and hashCode() implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with a null Thing ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson() method returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that an instance can be correctly created from a valid JSON string.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that getResourcePath() returns the correct JSON pointer.
